statement.text: (Grigorchuk) Aut(Fn) acts on the space ∂3Fn of triples of distinct ends of Fn. Denote by Yn the compact space (Cantor set) the quotient space of ∂3Fn by the group of inner automorphisms. Thus Out(Fn) acts on Yn. Describe the dynamics of this action; in particular the dynamics of any individual outer automorphism.

title: Questions in Geometric Group Theory — Q 12.11
